description: This file implements a Knockout.js-based TodoMVC application, including view model, custom bindings, and routing logic.

classes.name: Todo
classes.description: Represents a single todo item with observable properties for title, completion status, and editing state.

classes.name: ViewModel
classes.description: Main view model managing the list of todos, filtering, editing, and persistence.

methods.name: keyhandlerBindingFactory
methods.description: Factory function to create custom key event bindings for specific keycodes.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new todo item with the current input value.

methods.name: editItem
methods.description: Sets a todo item into editing mode.

methods.name: saveEditing
methods.description: Stops editing a todo item, updating or removing it if empty.

methods.name: cancelEditing
methods.description: Cancels editing mode and reverts to previous title.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns 'item' or 'items' based on the count for display purposes.
